answer: Attention Ledger requires each identity to sustain verified presence across randomly assigned long-duration tasks before gaining voice; a summit of task-hours must be reached, not merely purchased. An attacker must staff every identity to the bridge where work is reviewed, paying continuous labor cost for weeks. Missing shifts decays standing, so fake identities also lose orchard access to pooled rewards. Per-identity cost is sustained human hours, which scales linearly and makes mass identities unprofitable.
